project_type: TypeScript autonomous agent - Solana trading bot with Telegram interface
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm install` to install dependencies. 2. Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript compilation. 3. Run `npm test` to verify all tests pass.
environment_constraints: Node.js >=24 required. No Docker daemon needed for build/test.
contribution_requirements: Keep changes minimal and focused. Do not break existing functionality. All 489 tests must pass.
key_patterns: vitest for testing with describe/it/expect. Source in src/, tests in tests/ mirroring src/ structure. Uses zod for validation, grammy for Telegram bot, better-sqlite3 for persistence, winston for logging. Logger created via createLogger(module-name). Strategies implement a Strategy interface with evaluate() and execute() methods.
directory_structure: src/ - main source (core/, integrations/, services/, strategies/, telegram/, types/). tests/ - mirrors src/ structure. data/ - runtime data. services/ - separate microservices (Go, Rust, Python). Root has package.json, tsconfig.json, Dockerfile.
